name: Right-passage rate and search spend over public factual questions
purpose: Live run of scripts/web_search_bench.py through the production adapter built from the environment (evaluation/components/web_search_live): an answer phrase in the observation the planner would see over public factual questions, real backend calls, latency and tokens added, with search spend at the list price per call. Invariant arm (evaluation/components/web_search): fixture queries through each backend (serper, brave, tavily, searxng) and the fallback chain prove identical handling offline Read in this direction: maximise the chance the right passage appears in what the planner sees; minimise search spend per right answer, latency, and tokens added to the prompt. The live arm exercises only the backends configured in the environment, and the list price per call is an assumption to confirm with the vendor. The fixture payloads are written in each vendor's response shape, not recorded, so they prove handling, not relevance or freshness.
record: The pass rate, passed cases out of cases run, of each implementation on the same cases, with the recorded cost as the tie-break; each run is one row of the results file pinned to the commit and the cases hash, and the leaderboard compares rows only when the hash matches.
cascading_conditionals: unconfirmed: for Payal to confirm. idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the fallback_chain offline arm of web_search runs the whole case set with no model call, validating the cases and scorer before any model is paid for] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > live [real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=a person approved the spend under the metric run policy]
command: esoi run web_search_live --impl web_research; esoi run web_search --impl fallback_chain
